services.title: CERAMIC COATING
services.description: Ceramic coating forms a hard, transparent protective layer over your vehicle's clear coat. It bonds chemically with the paint, making the surface hydrophobic (water-repellent) and resistant to UV rays, dirt, bird droppings, tree sap, and chemical stains.
services.whatItDoes: Ceramic coating forms a hard, transparent protective layer over your vehicle's clear coat. It bonds chemically with the paint, making the surface hydrophobic (water-repellent) and resistant to UV rays, dirt, bird droppings, tree sap, and chemical stains.
services.realLifeExample: Imagine rain falling on a freshly waxed leaf. The water forms beads and rolls off. Ceramic coating does the same on your car. Instead of dirt sticking to the paint, most of it washes away easily, keeping your vehicle cleaner for longer.

services.title: GRAPHENE COATING
services.description: Graphene coating is an advanced version of ceramic coating. It provides better heat dissipation, improved water repellency, reduced water spotting, and longer-lasting paint protection.
services.whatItDoes: Graphene coating is an advanced version of ceramic coating. It provides better heat dissipation, improved water repellency, reduced water spotting, and longer-lasting paint protection.
services.realLifeExample: After parking your black car in the hot sun, ceramic coating protects the paint, but graphene also helps reduce heat buildup and minimizes water spots after rain or washing.

services.title: PAINT PROTECTION FILM (PPF)
services.description: PPF is a thick, transparent polyurethane film installed over the paint. It absorbs impacts from stones, road debris, scratches, and minor abrasions before they reach the paint.
services.whatItDoes: PPF is a thick, transparent polyurethane film installed over the paint. It absorbs impacts from stones, road debris, scratches, and minor abrasions before they reach the paint.
services.realLifeExample: A small stone hits your car at 100 km/h. Without PPF, it chips the paint. With PPF, the film absorbs the impact, leaving the original paint untouched.

services.title: PAINT CORRECTION
services.description: Paint correction removes a microscopic layer of damaged clear coat using machine polishing. This eliminates swirl marks, oxidation, light scratches, haze, and restores gloss.
services.whatItDoes: Paint correction removes a microscopic layer of damaged clear coat using machine polishing. This eliminates swirl marks, oxidation, light scratches, haze, and restores gloss.
services.realLifeExample: If your car looks dull with circular scratches visible under sunlight, paint correction levels the damaged surface, making the paint smooth and mirror-like again.
